H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H8050: Shemuel, the name of three Israelites
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H8199: to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively)
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H3100: Joel, the name of twelve Israelites
H4932: properly, a repetition, i.e. a duplicate (copy of a document), or a double (in amount); by implication, a second (in order, rank, age, quality or location)
H29: Abijah, the name of several Israelite men and two Israelitesses
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H5186: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application
H310: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
H3947: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
H4941: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H7414: Ramah, the name of four places in Palestine
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H6258: at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H7489: properly, to spoil (literally, by breaking to pieces); figuratively, to make (or be) good fornothing, i.e. bad (physically, socially or morally)
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H6419: to judge (officially or mentally); by extension, to intercede, pray
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H4427: to reign; inceptively, to ascend the throne; causatively, to induct into royalty; hence (by implication) to take counsel
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H4639: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H5927: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
H4714: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H5800: to loosen, i.e. relinquish, permit, etc.
H5647: to work (in any sense); by implication, to serve, till, (causatively) enslave, etc.
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H312: properly, hinder; generally, next, other, etc.
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H389: a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only
H5749: to duplicate or repeat; by implication, to protest, testify (as by reiteration); intensively, to encompass, restore (as a sort of reduplication)
H5046: properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
H7592: to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand
H854: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
H6571: a steed (as stretched out to a vehicle, not single nor for mounting ); also (by implication) a driver (in a chariot), i.e. (collectively) cavalry
H7323: to run (for whatever reason, especially to rush)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H8269: a head person (of any rank or class)
H505: hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand
H2790: to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to engrave, plough; hence (from the use of tools) to fabricate (of any material); figuratively, to devise (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be silent, to let alone; hence (by implication) to be deaf (as an accompaniment of dumbness)
H7114: to dock off, i.e. curtail (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative); especially to harvest (grass or grain)
H7105: severed, i.e. harvest (as reaped), the crop, the time, the reaper, or figuratively; also a limb (of a tree, or simply foliage)
H3627: something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon)
H4421: a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare)
H7393: a vehicle; by implication, a team; by extension, cavalry; by analogy a rider, i.e. the upper millstone
H1323: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
H2132: an olive (as yielding illuminating oil), the tree, the branch or the berry
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H2233: seed; figuratively, fruit, plant, sowing-time, posterity
H6237: to tithe, i.e. to take or give atenth
H5631: a eunuch; by implication, valet (especially of the female apartments), and thus, a minister of state
H8198: a female slave (as a member of the household)
H970: properly, selected, i.e. a youth (often collective)
H2543: a male ass (from its dun red)
H4399: properly, deputyship, i.e. ministry; generally, employment (never servile) or work (abstractly or concretely); also property (as the result of labor)
H6629: a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)
H2199: to shriek (from anguish or danger); by analogy, (as a herald) to announce or convene publicly
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H977: properly, to try, i.e. (by implication) select
H6030: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H3318: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
H3898: to feed on; figuratively, to consume; by implication, to battle (as destruction)
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H241: broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man)
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H5892: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
